title: China Mail 1939-05-09
subject: 德臣西報
德臣西报
China Mail
description: 200,000 EVACUATE RUINED CAPITAL. SEVEN EMERGERNCY HOSPITALS BEING BUILT. EMERGENCY HOSPITALS. 3,000 KILLED. FALSE ALARMS. MARTIAL LAW ERIMPOSED: HEAVY GUNFIRE. NORE GERMAN TIRADES AGAINST GREAT BRITAIN. Nazi Labour Minister's Essay In Abuse. "Ruthless, Brutal Covetous." GERMAN ALLEGATIONS OF TERRORISM. ITALIAN ARMY MANOEUVERS. DAREEST HRITAIN. HATRED THROUGH FEAR. Duke's Reply To Critics. M. GAFENCU TO VISIT TURKEY AND GREECE. "MEIN LEBEN" "NEXT"? Japanese Claim Success. KING SWIMS IN SHIP'S POOL. VICTORY PARADE RE "FIXED." R.A.F. MISSION IN FRANCE. COOPERATIVES TO CAMPAIGN. YUGOSLAV'S CHINA INTERESTS. PRINCESSES TOUR PIRT OF LONDON. Lord Halifax At The Japanese Embassy. VOLUNTARY SERVICE IN SOUTH AFRICA. SLIGHT DECREASE OF INMATES IN REFUGEE CAMPS. Business Outlook Hopeful. SAILORS' HOME HEAVILY TAXED. WEATHER FORECAST. MUSSOLINI MAY VISIT BERLIN TO SIGN AXIS MILITARY ALLIANCE. NO CHANGE. JOINT DEMANDS? ASTONISHING LANGUAGE IN GERMAN PRESS. WHAT ROME PRESS SAYS. GRANITE RAMPART!57 MASSACRE OF CHUNGKING: SCATHING DENUNCIATION OF THE JAPANESE. DUDDELL STREET ROBBERY. EX-EMPLOYEE'S FRAUD. JAPANESE PLANES FLY INTO H.K. TERRITORY. NO ACTION LIKELY. ANGLO-GERMAN NAVAL PLACT DENUNCIATION. DAIRY FARM ROOF MISHAP. MR. CHAMBERLAIN IS NOT AWARE. Adopts Stiff Attitude Towards Tory Back-Bencher. Will Not Admit Public Call For Soviet Pact. PREMIER'S DEFINITION. DILATOERINESS DENIED. EUROPEAN LADY A VICTIM. MARTIAL LAW FOR THREE HOURS. POTEMKIN IN BUCHAREST. Optimistic View Of Soviet Agreement Prospects. DEATH OF MR. F.M. XAVIER. ICHANG BOMBED. NO CHANGE IN SOVIET FOREIGN POLICY. SOVIET FILLS A VACANT POST. ARGUS VISITING. Military Training Bill Inadequate: SOVIET NEEDED TO REDEEM GUARANTEES. NO GROUND FOR FEARS. IN ADEQWUATE. THE GAPS. CONSIDERABLE CRITICISM. A BETTER GESTURE. HAD NOT SHOWN NEED. BELISHA'S REPLY. DIFFERENT ASSUMPTIONS. EXPORT SUBLSIDY POSSIBLE FOR LANCASHIRE. POSSIBLE SUBSIDY. DUKE OF WINDSOR. Inspiring Broadcast To America. NEED FOR UNDERSTANDING. POISONING MINDS. TERRIBLE FATE. ITALIAN ARMY TO BE "READY." LITHUANIA AND POLAND. R.A.F. RECRUITING. BATTERY OF QUESTIONS ON CHINA IN COMMONS. Japanese Demands On International Settlement. Britain Will Assist Council To Resist. MILITARY RESPONSIBLE. TEXT NOT YET AVAILABLE. BRITISH AID TO S.M.C. Another Sharp Fall. NICARAGUA CANAL SCHEME PRESSED. BALBO IN CAIRO. FULLY INFORMED. 176,933,236 GOT FROM COAL. 100 STUDENTS IN BY-ELECTION. "BRING IN RUSSIA." "POCKET MONET" POND. LAW LIST STILL GROWING. PROPAGANDA OF EARLY TIMES. MET BROTHER TO ARREST HIM. HOW AFRICA BUYS BRITISH. ALDERSHOT TATTOO MAKES PROFTT OF 42,000POUNDS. DOOR OPENS ITSELF. THEIR NUMBER ISN'T UP. Custards Bring Gay Note Into Everyday Cookery. HOW TO MAKE AND HOW TO SERVE THEM. HOW TO MAKE CUSTARDS. SNOW CUSTARD. SAVOURY ASPARAGUS CUSTARDS. THE MANSE CUSTARD. A STEAMED CUSTARD. TO VARY THE FLAVOUR. SAVOURY CUSTARD. ALMOND CUSTARB. 80 YEARS' OLD RECIPE. ALLIANCE LOGIGAL, SAYS RIBBENTROP. CROWD STARDS A RUMOUR. LOCAL CYCLING. MR. A.K. TAYLOR INVESTED WITH M.B.E. INSIGNIA. GAOL FOR KIDNAPPING. THRILLING GAME IN COLONY FINAL. PETER KANE RELINQUISHES FLYWEIGHT TITLE. WEST INDIES LOSE FIRST COUNTY MATCH. MIDDLESEX DARK HORSES? A. TRIBUTE. SINGLES FINAL TAILS OUT DEPRESSINGLY. Tsui Wai-Pui Completely Cvershadows Brother. WINNER LIKELY TO REIGN FOR MANY YEARS. DAVIS CUP PLAYERS ARRIVE ON THURSDAY. APPORTIONING OF GATE RECEIPTS. CEBTYRT AGAUBST MARTINEAU'S TEAM. PUBLIC AUCTION. VALUABLE HOUSEHOLD FURVITURE. PUBLIC AUCTION. DOLLAR ACADEMY. LOST. FOR SALE. WANTED KNOWN. DANCING TUITION. TUITION GIVEN. FOR SALE. SITUATION WANTED. M. BLUM TO TRY AND PERSUADE MAJOR ATTLEE. PARKING CASE. CLEAN SWEEPS FOR GERMANY, YUGIOSLAVIA. HENKEL'S EASY PASSAGE. PARIS WAITS FOR IL DUCE'STURIN SPEECH. KING OF ITALT TO VISIT BERLIN. GERMAN WWEDDING.
